world.h: Araghchi calls US outreach a 'positive step'
world.b: Iran's foreign minister called a US call for dialogue a positive step as an Iranian delegation arrived in Doha. Al Jazeera is following the Iran war live.
world.title: Araghchi says US call for dialogue a positive step; Iran delegation in Doha

national.h: Two Chinese nationals jailed for spying
national.b: The pair were each sentenced to 30 months in prison for a scheme that sought to arrange 'dead drop' cash payments for US national security information, the DOJ said.

national.h: Pope Leo casts mail ballot in US midterms
national.b: The Vatican confirmed the Chicago-born pope submitted a mail-in ballot in Chicago, making him the first pontiff to vote in a US general election.

national.h: Christa Pike says she is in constant pain
national.b: In her first statement since her failed execution, Pike, 50, said through her lawyers that she is in constant physical and emotional pain and struggling to speak.

national.h: ICE officer charged with assault in Houston
national.b: Prosecutors say the officer struck and ran over a man fleeing on foot in a parking lot Oct. 10, breaking his leg. The DA said video contradicts ICE's account.

national.h: Early voting surges in Senate battlegrounds
national.b: More than 6.3 million Texans had voted early as of Wednesday, up 50% from four years ago, per an AP analysis. South Carolina's early vote is up 83%.

national.h: Veterans pay more after VA ends loan program
national.b: An NPR investigation found more than 15,000 veterans with modified VA-backed mortgages saw payments rise at least $150 a month after the Trump administration shut down a low-interest program; more than 700 saw increases of $1,000 or more.

politics.h: Alaska US attorney confirms spoiler candidate probe
politics.b: U.S. Attorney Michael Heyman said a months-long criminal probe has seen a 'significant surge' of agents after reports Peltola's campaign helped recruit a Dan J. Sullivan to run.
politics.title: Justice Department seeks to isolate Alaska ballots as criminal probe underway over Senate candidate

politics.h: Judge orders inquiry into DOJ conduct in golf case
politics.b: Judge Ana Reyes is examining whether officials misrepresented plans for D.C.'s East Potomac golf course after DOJ lawyers confirmed a plan to close it and much of the park in mid-November.

politics.h: Appeals court again rejects bid to set aside CA ballots
politics.b: The 9th Circuit ruled the Trump administration's request to set aside 20,000 California ballots over non-citizen voting concerns would violate the Constitution and risk disenfranchising eligible voters.

politics.h: Trump reinstates canceled Kansas, Iowa rallies
politics.b: A source close to the administration told Al Jazeera that Trump will headline the previously canceled rallies in person ahead of Tuesday's midterms.

politics.h: Democrats aim to cut GOP lead in statehouses
politics.b: More than 6,100 state legislative seats are on the ballot. Republicans control 28 legislatures and Democrats 18, with the remaining four divided or under power-sharing deals.

politics.h: DOJ renews bid to block Alaska results
politics.b: The Justice Department filed a revised lawsuit seeking to decertify Alaska's Senate race if Sen. Dan Sullivan loses narrowly.

international.h: Syria weighs joining Mecca defence pact
international.b: Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani said talks are under way on Syria entering the pact signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan, which treats an attack on one as an attack on all.
international.title: Syria considering entry into Mecca defence pact, says foreign minister

international.h: Yemen fighting has displaced 290,000, UN says
international.b: OCHA says renewed fighting between government forces and the Houthis, especially in Taiz and coastal areas, has displaced 290,000 since August, with pregnant women at dire risk.
international.title: New Yemen fighting displaces 290,000, says UN, with pregnant women at risk

international.h: Oleshky evacuees reach Ukraine via Belarus
international.b: Residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky arrived in Ukraine under a localized ceasefire brokered by Melania Trump, expected to last through Sunday evening.
international.title: Residents evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky reach Ukraine after localized ceasefire

international.h: Burnham opens door to UK slave trade apology
international.b: Ahead of a Commonwealth summit in Antigua and Barbuda, Andy Burnham offered structured talks, including on whether Britain should issue an official state apology.
international.title: Burnham opens door to formal apology for Britain’s slave trade

international.b: The individuals face charges including weapons possession and undermining state security after a truck carrying explosives was seized at the Dahr al-Baydar checkpoint.

international.h: Rival Western Sahara resolutions fail at UN
international.b: Russia vetoed a US-backed proposal supported by 11 council members, and a Russian draft fell short, with the MINURSO mission's mandate due to expire Saturday.

international.h: US approves $2.1bn Patriot missile sale to Ukraine
international.b: The State Department approved the possible sale of 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles, one of the biggest steps to supply Kyiv with defensive weapons since Trump's second term began.

international.h: Senior RSF commander defects, alleging nepotism
international.b: Commander Ander accused relatives of RSF leader Hemedti of tightly controlling the group's finances, weapons and promotions, the latest in a string of defections this year.

international.h: DR Congo Ebola death toll passes 5,000
international.b: The country's deadliest outbreak on record has infected more than 10,000 people since May; there are no approved treatments or vaccines for the Bundibugyo strain.

international.h: Brazil summons Argentine envoy over Bolsonaro flight
international.b: Brazil called in Argentina's charge d'affaires after Flavio Bolsonaro fled to Argentina and then the US following his election loss. Argentina denied receiving a formal request.

international.h: Germany and France brace for Halloween protests
international.b: About 150,000 people have registered to protest Saturday in some 30 German cities, led by the 'GenZ regelt!' group; some stores boarded up windows.

international.h: Port Sudan families can barely afford water
international.b: Without piped water, families in Port Sudan's Deim Mayo neighbourhood rely on street vendors; one mother says a month of water costs her entire salary.

international.h: Canada moves toward EU associate membership
international.b: Prime Minister Carney said Canada is working toward becoming the EU's first associate member, though the Montreal summit declaration instead pledged an 'ever-closer association' by 2027.

international.h: Israel demolishes homes of Hebron attackers
international.b: Troops demolished the homes of two brothers killed after an Oct. 23 attack that killed two Israeli soldiers, on the eighth day of an offensive and siege on Hebron.

international.h: Houthis claim six attacks on Saudi airports, oil sites
international.b: Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree said the attacks targeted vital commercial and military infrastructure across Saudi Arabia, despite recent Saudi-Iranian talks on resolving differences through dialogue.

international.h: EU force helicopter crash kills four in Bosnia
international.b: A CH-47 Chinook with the EU force crashed during training in the Brcko region, killing four and injuring 11. Italy's government said all on board were Italian.

business.h: Oil giants' earnings soar again on Iran war
business.b: ExxonMobil earned $15.4 billion, Shell $10.8 billion and Chevron $9.9 billion as the war disrupted supply; Brent crude trades near $113 a barrel, up from about $70.

business.h: Employment costs rose 0.8% in third quarter
business.b: The Bureau of Labor Statistics' Employment Cost Index, which tracks wages and benefits, rose 0.8% in Q3, down from 0.9% in Q2.
business.title: This measure of labor costs can signal when inflation's on the way

business.h: Binance hit by $6.3B hack tied to North Korea
business.b: Blockchain firm TRM attributed the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor unit. Binance said it froze about $3 billion, suspended withdrawals and will cover all losses.
business.title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance

business.h: Officials ramp up scrutiny of sports betting apps
business.b: Gaming regulators, government lawyers and federal lawmakers have launched inquiries into DraftKings and others after a ProPublica investigation into their responsible-gaming guardrails.
business.title: Federal and State Officials Ramp Up Scrutiny of DraftKings, Other Sports Betting Apps

science.h: Striped bass could face collapse, scientists warn
science.b: After years of heavy fishing, the big striper runs have faded and young fish are harder to find, worrying anglers from Montauk to the Chesapeake.
science.title: For many, striped bass fishing is a way of life. But the iconic species could face collapse

science.h: Secret UN vote boosted carbon capture, ProPublica finds
science.b: A 2005 U.N. climate report suggested at least 99% of stored CO2 would likely stay underground despite scant evidence; major storage projects have since faced breakdowns and cost overruns.
science.title: How a Secret Vote by U.N. Scientists Legitimized Carbon Capture and Skewed Decades of Climate Policy

sports.h: Colts in Jonathan Taylor trade talks
sports.b: Indianapolis (2-5), which already dealt Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner this week, has received at least one offer including a second-round pick, per ESPN. Taylor says he hasn't requested a trade.
sports.title: Colts actively engaged in Jonathan Taylor trade talks: Five teams reportedly interested in star running back

sports.h: Warriors rally past Lakers despite rookie's rough night
sports.b: Yaxel Lendeborg had six points and five turnovers against Luka Dončić and the Lakers, but Golden State came back to win in the NBA Cup group-stage opener.
sports.title: Luka Dončić teaches Yaxel Lendeborg a lesson, but Warriors bail their rookie out in comeback win over Lakers

sports.h: Reigning NHL MVP Kucherov requests a trade
sports.b: The two-time Hart Trophy winner, 33, is in the final year of a contract paying $9.5 million a season after a 44-goal, 86-assist MVP campaign.
sports.title: Nikita Kucherov trade request: Five potential landing spots for the reigning NHL MVP

sports.h: Jacobs says TD celebration was about gospel song
sports.b: Packers RB Josh Jacobs said his celebration against the Panthers, which some saw as mimicking handcuffs, referenced the gospel song 'Break Every Chain.'

sports.h: Packers' Watson returns after hospital visit
sports.b: Christian Watson left with a chest injury, was taken to a hospital for precautionary tests, then returned after halftime against the Panthers with extra padding around his ribs.

sports.h: Bears trade for Titans DT Jeffery Simmons
sports.b: Tennessee agreed to send the four-time Pro Bowler to Chicago for first-round picks in 2027 and 2028 and a 2027 fourth-rounder.

goodnews.h: Maryland man grows oysters to revive the Chesapeake
goodnews.b: With oyster stocks plunged, a Kent Island resident raises them off his pier; his nets are packed with oysters after just three months of growth.

local.h: Jersey City pre-K busing hits crisis point
local.b: Overcrowding at P.S. 16 in booming Paulus Hook means its pre-K toddlers are bused across the city because the building has no room for them.
local.title: Pre-K busing in downtown Jersey City's hitting a crisis point, parents say

local.h: Bronx e-bike fire death toll rises to four
local.b: Two teenage boys and a woman have died alongside Zion Maine after an e-bike battery ignited in the family's 11th-floor kitchen, blocking their exit.
local.title: Bronx e-bike fire that killed a boy has claimed 3 more lives, NYPD says

local.h: Rooftop work wrecks Upper West Side owl nest
local.b: Politicians, police and wildlife officers rushed to West 75th Street to stop water tower work that disturbed a nest of seven barn owls.
local.title: 'It is a crime!': Upper West Side owl lovers outraged after rooftop work wrecks nest

local.h: NYCHA says Marcy Houses asbestos removed
local.b: A steam leak left asbestos-laden residue on exterior walls in Bed-Stuy; residents had complained for weeks and some lost heat and hot water.
local.title: NYCHA says it's removed asbestos found at Brooklyn’s Marcy Houses

local.h: Suit says Two Trees illegally raised rents
local.b: A class-action lawsuit accuses the Brooklyn developer of skirting tax-break rules and illegally raising rents at one of its buildings.
local.title: Influential Brooklyn developer illegally raised rents despite tax break, lawsuit claims

local.h: Democrats' NJ-7 early vote lead keeps growing
local.b: Early turnout in New Jersey's 7th District has swamped 2024 totals, giving Democrats an edge in their bid to unseat Rep. Tom Kean Jr.
local.title: Democrats' early voting lead in NJ keeps growing ahead of Election Day

local.h: Council takes up Mamdani's community safety agency
local.b: The City Council holds a hearing Friday on creating a Department of Community Safety, one of Mayor Mamdani's top campaign promises on violence prevention and mental health response.
local.title: NYC Council takes key step toward Mamdani's promised Department of Community Safety

periods.name: Monday Night
periods.text: Partly cloudy, with a low around 53.

localgood.h: Formerly homeless New Yorkers lead outreach
localgood.b: Outreach worker Felipe Ramos, who cycled through homelessness himself, says his past is his superpower in getting people off Manhattan's streets.
localgood.title: How formerly homeless New Yorkers are helping others get off the streets

localgood.h: Hate crime survivor reclaims his marathon dream
localgood.b: A year after an attack cost him his first marathon, Daniel Cho will join more than 18,000 first-timers at this year's NYC Marathon.
localgood.title: A violent hate crime claimed one NYC man's marathon dream. A year later, he's taking it back.
